scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test:db-smoke && npm run test:db-install
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src frontend/src config scripts tests
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
